name: Webhook JSON to PDF, sent by email (pdfrender)

parameters.content:
## Webhook JSON to PDF, sent by email

A POST with a JSON body arrives, a Code node turns the fields you choose into an HTML document, pdfrender renders it to a PDF, and Gmail sends the PDF as an attachment.

**Try it**: the Webhook node has pinned sample data, so **Execute workflow** runs end to end without a real call. Unpin it to receive live requests.

API key: https://pdfrender.dev/go/tpl-webhook-json-to-pdf-email?to=/app/api-keys

### Setup

1. **Receive order JSON**: copy the production URL and POST your JSON to it. The node answers at once; the PDF is made afterwards.
2. **Build HTML**: edit the field names and the HTML. Only fields named there reach the PDF, and every value is HTML-escaped.
3. **pdfrender node**: on self-hosted n8n, open **Settings > Community Nodes**, install `@pdfrender-dev/n8n-nodes-pdfrender`, then add a **pdfrender API** credential with your API key. On n8n Cloud, which installs only verified community nodes, replace this node with an HTTP Request node: `POST https://api.pdfrender.dev/v1/render`, header `X-API-Key`, a JSON body with the fields `html` and `filename` (Using Fields Below) and Response Format **File**. The README has the details.
4. **Email the PDF**: add a Gmail credential. The recipient comes from `customer.email` in the payload.
